FN-9JAGJBB-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 194
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 194 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State Board of Medical
Examiners and the Board of Nursing by $600, respectively, for each meeting of the Joint
Committee of the State Board of Medical Examiners and the Board of Nursing for Advanced
Practice Nurses by increasing the per diem for committee members from $100, under current
law, to $300, as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-9JAGJBB-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 194
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/26/2025
House Bill 194 as reported by the Committee on Boards, Agencies and Commissions could
increase or decrease the obligations of the State Board of Medical Examiners and the Board of
Nursing by an undetermined amount for each meeting of the Joint Committee of the State Board
of Medical Examiners and the Board of Nursing for Advanced Practice Nurses dependent on the
difference in the per diem rate set by each board, respectively, as provided by this bill and the
current per diem of $100 for committee members.
Page 1

FN-9JAGJBB-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 194
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/18/2025
House Bill 194 as passed the House of Representatives could increase or decrease the
obligations of the State Board of Medical Examiners and the Board of Nursing by an
undetermined amount for each meeting of the Joint Committee of the State Board of Medical
Examiners and the Board of Nursing for Advanced Practice Nurses held dependent on the
difference in the per diem rate set by each board, respectively, as provided by this bill and the
current per diem of $100 for committee members.
